To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the interaction with "emotional" VR worlds can produce specific emotions, and that the feeling of presence is influenced by the emotional state of the subject and vice versa.
(1) the interaction with virtual environments can induce emotions, (2) emotions can influence presence, (3) presence can influence emotions, and (4) presence and emotions are circularly related.

1) Virtual reality can be used as an affective communication medium; 2) Presence is a key variable in the affective experience of VR; 3) The feeling of presence is influenced by the emotional content of the virtual environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach for the analysis of affective interactions using virtual reality.
the use of virtual environments (VE) for the induction of emotional responses, and with the relationship between the feeling of presence and emotions.
the development of a theory of affective interactions in virtual reality.

the present study has provided a first demonstration that virtual reality can be used to elicit emotions in a controlled manner.
the results of this study confirm the efficacy of VR to be an affective medium and the existence of an interplay between presence and emotions in the VR experience.
the present study has provided a first step in the direction of a better understanding of the relationship between VR, presence, and emotion.

we have found a link between presence and emotions in a virtual environment.
the results of our study showed that the feeling of presence can be used as a mediator between emotions and the virtual environment.
